summary: Stateful single-byte-delimiter string tokenizer (strtok-like) over the shared scan-state global dword_8CFAE4. If a1 is non-null it becomes the new scan state, otherwise a1 is reloaded from dword_8CFAE4 to resume a previous tokenization. Scans for the first byte equal to delimiter a2 or the end of string; if the scan never advanced the result is NULL, otherwise the delimiter is overwritten with a NUL terminator, the saved state advances past it, and the token start pointer is returned.

operations.description: If a1 is non-null, persist it as the new scan position in global dword_8CFAE4; otherwise reload a1 from dword_8CFAE4 to resume the previous tokenization.
Remember the scan start as the token candidate v3 = a1 and load its first character v2 = *a1.
If the string is empty (*a1 == 0), no token exists and the result is NULL.
do-while scan advancing a1 until the current character equals delimiter a2 or the end of string is reached, storing each new position into global dword_8CFAE4.
If the scan never advanced (a1 == v3, delimiter at the first position), the produced token is empty so v3 becomes NULL.
When a delimiter was reached (current character non-zero), terminate the token by writing 0 at a1 and advance global dword_8CFAE4 past the delimiter.
Return the token start pointer v3, or NULL when no token was produced.
Called by sub_564110 (0x00564110) and AudioMixerPollingUpdateLoop (0x00564390), which share the scan-state global.

unresolved: Global dword_8CFAE4 is shared tokenizer state; the owning object that resets it between sessions is unknown.
Only a single-byte delimiter is supported; the delimiter-set semantics used by the callers are unknown.
The exact callers' token-consumption context (which string, which delimiter) is not evidenced here.
